title: LeetCodeToGit - Because Your Hard-Earned Solutions Deserve a Home 🏡

sections.title: Never Lose a LeetCode Solution Again!
sections.description:
You spent hours debugging that tricky DP problem, finally got it right, and… forgot to save it somewhere safe? 🤦‍♂️

LeetCodeToGit ensures that never happens again! This command-line tool automatically fetches your best LeetCode submissions and syncs them to a local or remote Git repository.

With just a few commands:

  • All your hard-earned solutions are securely stored and easily accessible.
  • No more manual copy-pasting or expired sessions.
  • Just solve, sync, and flex your repository. 🚀

sections.title: How It Works - The Magic Behind the Sync 🔄
sections.description:
LeetCodeToGit follows a structured process to fetch, commit, and push your solutions:

  • Step 1: Initialization
    • Creates a local Git repository (if it doesn’t exist).
    • Connects to LeetCode using cookies for authentication 🍪.
    • Verifies push permissions (if syncing to GitHub).
  • Step 2: Fetching Solutions
    • Retrieves all solved problems based on difficulty level.
    • Fetches the best submission for each problem.
    • Skips already synced solutions to avoid duplicates.
  • Step 3: Committing & Organizing
    • Saves code files using a structured format 🗂️.
    • Updates the README with problem summaries 📜.
    • Creates detailed commit messages for easy tracking.
  • Step 4: Pushing to GitHub (Optional)
    • Syncs everything to a remote GitHub repository.
    • Rolls back failed pushes if --deleteIfFail is enabled ⚠️.

sections.title: Installation & Setup - Get Up and Running in Minutes ⏳
sections.description:
Setting up LeetCodeToGit is super simple:

  1. Clone the repository 
    git clone <repo_url>
cd leetcode-git-sync
  2. Install required dependencies 
    pip install -r requirements.txt
  3. Authenticate with LeetCode
    • Open your browser’s Developer Tools → Network Tab.
    • Find a request to www.leetcode.com/graphql.
    • Copy your cookies and paste them into leetcode_cookies.txt.

That’s it! You’re ready to sync your solutions. 🚀

sections.title: Using the Tool - Command-Line Power at Your Fingertips 💻
sections.description:
LeetCodeToGit comes with powerful CLI options to tailor the syncing process:

python main.py --difficulty emh --remote https://github.com/user/leetcode-solutions.git --gittoken YOUR_GIT_TOKEN

Supported Flags:

Flag Required Description
--remote ❌ Specifies the remote repository URL
--localName ❌ Name of the local Git repository
--gittoken ❌ Git token for authentication (if needed)
--difficulty ✅ Combination of e, m, h (Easy, Medium, Hard)
--deleteIfFail ❌ Rolls back commits if remote push fails

sections.title: Technical Details - The Engine Running Behind the Scenes ⚙️
sections.description:
LeetCodeToGit is designed for efficiency and reliability. Here’s a breakdown of its inner workings:

  • LeetCode Data Fetching
    • Uses GraphQL API to retrieve submissions.
    • Authenticates using user cookies (manually provided).
    • Filters out duplicate or low-quality submissions.
  • Git Operations
    • Uses Python subprocess to interact with Git.
    • Commits each problem separately with metadata-rich messages.
    • Allows rollback of failed pushes using --deleteIfFail.
  • Structure & Deployment
    • Backend: Python + GraphQL API.
    • File Organization: Solutions saved in structured folders 📂.
    • Optimized for Automation: Can be run via cron jobs for periodic syncing ⏳.
